about.description:
codegraph builds a pre-indexed knowledge graph of your codebase and
keeps it synced on code changes, so coding agents (Claude Code, Codex,
Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, AntiGravity, Kiro, Hermes) can answer
structure questions from the graph instead of re-reading files —
fewer tokens and fewer tool calls, fully local. Built from source: a
TypeScript CLI plus a Rust/napi native extraction kernel (tree-sitter
parse+extract) compiled for this platform, with a WASM tree-sitter
pipeline as the runtime fallback when the native kernel is unavailable.

Run ``codegraph`` in a repository to index it and wire up the agent
integrations.
about.summary: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph for coding agents - fewer tokens, fewer tool calls, 100% local

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.6.0"

package:
  name: codegraph
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9b264c584395e69595d0b8c602a7f5c65a19d16a26673953721829f32cfda119

build:
  number: 0
  # Upstream issue #81: Node 25+ V8 turboshaft WASM JIT breaks codegraph at
  # startup. nodejs is a pinned variant key, so skip the variants we cannot use
  # rather than letting them fail to solve against the host bound below.
  skip:
    - match(nodejs, ">=25")

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - nodejs
    - pnpm
    - pnpm-licenses
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - nodejs
  run:
    - nodejs

tests:
  - script:
      - codegraph --help
      - >-
        node -e "
          const path=require('path');
          const prefix=process.env.PREFIX||process.env.CONDA_PREFIX;
          const base=process.platform === 'win32' ?
            path.join(prefix, 'node_modules') :
            path.join(prefix, 'lib', 'node_modules');
          const loaderPath = path.join(base, '@colbymchenry', 'codegraph', 'dist', 'extraction', 'kernel', 'loader.js');
          const {getKernel} = require(loaderPath);
          const k = getKernel();
          if (!k) {
            console.error('native kernel failed to load');
            process.exit(1);
          };
          const info = k.contractInfo();
          if (!info.languages || info.languages.length === 0) {
            console.error('kernel loaded but reports zero languages');
            process.exit(1);
          };
          console.log('native kernel OK:', info.languages.join(','));
        "
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - ${{ 'node_modules' if win else 'lib/node_modules' }}/@colbymchenry/codegraph/package.json
        - ${{ 'node_modules' if win else 'lib/node_modules' }}/@colbymchenry/codegraph/dist/bin/codegraph.js
        - ${{ 'node_modules' if win else 'lib/node_modules' }}/@colbymchenry/codegraph/kernel/codegraph-kernel.node

about:
  summary: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph for coding agents - fewer tokens, fewer tool calls, 100% local
  description: |
    codegraph builds a pre-indexed knowledge graph of your codebase and
    keeps it synced on code changes, so coding agents (Claude Code, Codex,
    Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, AntiGravity, Kiro, Hermes) can answer
    structure questions from the graph instead of re-reading files —
    fewer tokens and fewer tool calls, fully local. Built from source: a
    TypeScript CLI plus a Rust/napi native extraction kernel (tree-sitter
    parse+extract) compiled for this platform, with a WASM tree-sitter
    pipeline as the runtime fallback when the native kernel is unavailable.

    Run ``codegraph`` in a repository to index it and wire up the agent
    integrations.
  homepage: https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph
  repository: https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph
  documentation: https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph#readme
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - third-party-licenses.txt
    - codegraph-kernel/THIRDPARTY.yml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
